environment.description: AWS Lambda function running in Step Functions workflow. Python 3.9 runtime on Amazon Linux 2. DOCUMENT_ROOT=/var/task/documents. Lambda execution role has s3:GetObject and ssm:GetParameter permissions. The /var/task directory contains the deployment package with environment variables in .env file at /var/task/.env containing database credentials. No filesystem isolation beyond standard Lambda sandbox. Step Functions workflow accepts input directly from API Gateway without input validation state.

config.network: VPC with NAT gateway, no egress filtering
